en.hubeali: From him, from his father, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from one of his companions, from Abu Ayoub Al Khazzaz, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said,
‘I saw Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> and the barber was plucking from his<sup>asws</sup> beard, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Curve it’.
en.sarwar: 5. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from his father from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from certain persons of his people from abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “
I once saw abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, when the barber trimmed his beard, he (the Imam) said, ‘Make it round.’”
